title: NEXSOLVE SIH 26153 World Model Data Foundation
scope: Phase 1-4 evidence only; no model training or production changes

local_packet_level_inventory.filename_search_result: No matching packet-capture or packet-derived filenames were found.
local_packet_level_inventory.content_search_result: No local packet-level artifact was found. Existing CSVs are flow or event tables.
local_packet_level_inventory.important_negative_finding: No local file provides raw packet observations for TTL variance, per-packet payload distribution, fragment flags, or retransmission evidence. Flow aggregates must not be represented as packet-level observations.

authoritative_sources.evidence: UNB states that the public distribution includes full packet payloads in PCAP format and labeled flows. It documents five days, benign Monday traffic, and attacks plus normal activity on Tuesday-Friday.
UNSW states that raw network data includes PCAP, Zeek logs and CSVs, and separately documents processed data and timestamped security-event ground truth.
UNSW states that raw packets were captured as PCAP and that Bro/Argus-derived CSV features are provided.

smallest_practical_official_packet_sourc.official_source: UNB CIC-IDS2017 download page: https://www.unb.ca/cic/datasets/ids-2017.html; download gate: http://cicresearch.ca/CICDataset/CIC-IDS-2017/
smallest_practical_official_packet_sourc.access_method: Use the official UNB/CIC download form, select the single Friday afternoon port-scan PCAP, retain the downloaded filename and SHA-256, and do not download the full five-day set.

size.published_context: UNB publishes 8.3 GB for the complete Friday capture day, not a separate byte size for this scenario file.
size.status: UNKNOWN until official download/access and local stat

smallest_practical_official_packet_sourc.benign_traffic: Yes at the day level: the official page describes Friday as attacks plus normal activity. The exact scenario-file benign row/packet proportion must be measured after download.
smallest_practical_official_packet_sourc.attack_traffic: Yes: Friday afternoon includes Port Scan and DDoS LOIT; this file is the port-scan scenario target.
smallest_practical_official_packet_sourc.temporal_information: Yes in the raw PCAP packet timestamps; the official page documents Friday port-scan intervals from approximately 13:55 to 15:29. Packet timestamp precision and timezone must be verified from the file.
smallest_practical_official_packet_sourc.overlap_with_network_dataset_23: Not established. CIC-IDS2017 and TON-IoT Network 23 are different experiments, dates, hosts and address spaces. The filename similarity to a flow CSV is not correspondence evidence.
smallest_practical_official_packet_sourc.why_this_is_smallest: A single scenario file exercises timestamps, benign/attack context, port-scan signatures and packet extraction while avoiding the full multi-day CIC PCAP download. It is a development fixture, not sufficient final training data.

flow_packet_alignment.network_23_status: The local file has ts and the five tuple fields, but has flow start/record timestamps rather than a packet table.
required_test: extract packet timestamps and five tuples from the selected PCAP
compare time tolerance and tuple keys
measure matched flow coverage and one-to-many mappings
reject alignment if coverage or provenance is insufficient
flow_packet_alignment.current_conclusion: Schema-level alignment is feasible in principle; actual packet-to-Network_23 alignment is UNKNOWN and must not be claimed before the measured join. GroundTruth_Network_18 must not manufacture labels.

additional_data_reason: At least one official raw PCAP is required to validate the extractor. More captures or a verified packet/flow pair are required before claiming dataset-specific alignment or full SIH packet coverage.
next_step: Acquire only the official CIC-IDS2017 Friday-WorkingHours-Afternoon-PortScan.pcap, record size and SHA-256, then inspect its packet timestamp, tuple, TTL, TCP option/window, payload, fragment and retransmission availability.
